claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation text states the underlying vendor request is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Dolos maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides resource-efficient access to chain data without the overhead of traditional full nodes.

The proposal states Dolos connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes five query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli and Ogmios.
The proposal states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors, with a GitHub repository link provided for verification.

The proposal claims Dolos achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting results, documentation, and audit materials.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal states audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

The proposal states treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs smart contract tooling using a TRSC and PSSC with specified addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The anchor requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance grant administered by Intersect, with claims of open-source utility, prior ecosystem traction, Intersect budget approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
